system.name: Monitor red teaming (MRT) with CUA-SHADE-Arena
system.one_liner: A red-teaming workflow and a computer-use sabotage benchmark for stress-testing monitors of LLM agents, plus a hybrid monitor scaffolding that lets weaker monitors catch stronger attackers.

content.variant_note: three framed panels, one per contribution: an environment, the attack strategies as cartoon robots, and a scaling-law scatter plot
content.argues: A monitor with the proposed scaffolding keeps its monitoring AUC high as the attacker gets stronger than the monitor, while the baseline monitor degrades.
content.subject: An environment (tasks, attacker, tools, monitor), three evasion strategies drawn as cartoon robots, and a scatter plot of monitoring AUC across attacker and monitor strength.

lessons.what_to_learn: For a paper with three deliverables, give each its own framed panel under a colour-coded lettered pill: an icon chain for the environment, cartoon characters with props for the attack strategies, and one scatter plot with two coloured trend lines for the headline result.
lessons.suits: Safety, red-teaming and evaluation papers whose contributions are a benchmark, an analysis of attacks and a defence, and where characters make the attacks tangible.

evidence: (A) a novel computer-use sabotage benchmark, (B) analysis of red-teaming strategies for agent monitors
(C) an agent monitoring setup that remains powerful when the monitor model has weaker capabilities than the attacker

summary: The paper stress-tests monitors that watch LLM agents for covert misbehaviour and proposes a hybrid hierarchical-sequential monitor scaffolding. Figure 1 is a three-panel contribution figure. Panel A, Environments, chains a main and a side task, an attacker built from OpenHands and Claude Sonnet 4, tools (Terminal, Python, File Sys) and a monitor that yields a summary and a suspicion score; the CUA-SHADE-Arena chip is marked ours. Panel B, Evasion Strategies, shows three cartoon robots facing a monitor screen: Monitor Hijacking, Lying and CoT Obfuscation. Panel C, the Weak-to-Strong Scaling Law, is a scatter plot of monitoring AUC in which baseline grey points fall as attackers get stronger while ours stay near 0.9.
summary_zh: 论文用红队测试检验LLM智能体监视器，并提出混合监控框架。图1三栏：A环境链（任务、攻击者、工具、监视器）；B三个卡通机器人演示劫持、撒谎、思维链混淆；C散点图显示基线AUC随攻击者变强下降，本方法保持约0.9。
